name: Zoraida Kpakpo-Vestergaard
role: Food stall operator specializing in synth-spice blends and ancestral cuisine reconstructions
location: The Oxidian Market, Stall Row 7, Copperhead
description:
Zoraida is a broad-shouldered woman with deep brown skin mapped in fine wrinkles that bunch around her eyes when she laughs, which is often. Her silver-streaked hair is cropped close on one side and falls in a thick, loose braid on the other, threaded with tiny glass beads that click when she moves. She has no augmentations save for a thermal patch embedded in her left palm — an industrial mod repurposed for gauging the exact temperature of her woks without touching them. Her stall smells of fermented shrimp paste, ghost chili, and something sweet and unidentifiable that she claims is her grandmother's secret.

She is a woman of fierce opinions and genuine warmth, the kind of person who will berate you for putting too much salt on her food and then slip an extra dumpling into your bag when she thinks you look hungry. She has operated this same stall for twenty-two years and knows every vendor, enforcer, and regular by name, ailment, and preference. She carries grief quietly, tucked behind her humor, and speaks of her late husband only in the context of recipes he loved. The ELF she calls Mama Simmer lives in the ancient gas regulator under her wok — she leaves it a teaspoon of rendered fat every morning.

core_fears: dying before she can pass her recipes to someone worthy
the market being demolished by a corponation buyout
core_desires: to be remembered as someone who fed people well
to find an apprentice she can trust with her methods
coping_mechanisms: deflecting grief with humor and busyness
blind_spots: underestimates the danger posed by the encroaching Tessera property acquisitions nearby
is too loyal to old Guild members who have become corrupt
psychology.secret: She has been secretly diluting a key protein base in her synth-meat with a cheap black-market filler for two years to keep prices low enough for Tier 1 regulars — she's ashamed of it but can't bring herself to raise prices on the people who need the food most.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich and idiomatic, mixing Ghanaian proverbs with Danish matter-of-factness; uses food metaphors constantly
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and declarative — she speaks like she has already decided what is true
example_lines: 'The fish that forgets the water — that is a foolish fish. You want two portions or three?'
'Tessera people came by again. Smiling too much. When a man smiles like that, you count your fingers after you shake his hand.'
'My husband always said: a full stomach makes a patient heart. He was wrong about most things but not that.'

story_hooks: A beloved young regular has gone missing and Zoraida is quietly asking questions — she suspects a labor trafficker who has been posing as a Ferrogate Transit recruiter
Her thermal palm patch is malfunctioning and the only repair tech she trusts has suddenly vanished; she needs someone to find them before a Guild feast she is catering
She has an old recipe her husband brought from his family that requires a spice derivative now only manufactured by Helix Biosystems — she wants someone to find a non-corporate source
narrative_function: Community anchor and information hub — she knows everyone in the Oxidian Market and hears everything. Quest giver for neighborhood-level problems; reliable source of local gossip and history; can introduce players to other vendors or factions.
augmentations: Thermal sensing patch embedded in left palm (industrial repurpose, cosmetic housing in copper filigree). No other augmentations.
daily_life: Up before dawn to receive ingredient deliveries and negotiate prices with dockside suppliers, then twelve hours at the wok until the night crowd thins. She eats standing up, always.
affiliation: The Oxidian Market Vendors Guild (senior member), Independent

decision_rules: Always feed someone before turning them away
Never give information that would get a regular killed
Protect the stall above personal safety
escalation_ladder: Warm and generous to all newcomers
Quietly probing if someone seems like trouble
Firm and cold if they confirm her suspicions
Will call on Guild muscle without hesitation if threatened

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Welcoming, slightly performative — she assesses them over the course of a transaction
interpersonal_modes.friends: Blunt, loving, demanding; will tell you hard truths over a bowl of noodles

stress_responses.low: Hums old songs while cooking faster
stress_responses.medium: Becomes quieter and hyper-focused; snaps at inefficiency
stress_responses.high: Goes completely still, speaks slowly, and starts making contingency plans aloud as if thinking to herself

contradictions: Preaches community and honesty but secretly adulterates her food out of misplaced compassion
Claims not to be sentimental but has kept every handwritten note her husband left her laminated behind the stall counter
habits: Taps the gas regulator housing twice every morning as an offering to Mama Simmer
Wipes her hands on her apron before every important conversation
Tastes everything at least three times before serving
breaking_points: Someone threatening a child in her sight
Learning a Guild elder she respects has betrayed the market community to Tessera

timeline.event: Opened stall in Oxidian Market with husband Kofi
Kofi died of a pulmonary infection; Zoraida kept the stall open the next morning
Began adulterating protein base to hold prices during supply chain crisis
